name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Either 5 ly goes with Dasari or Beacon goes with 9 ly.
9 ly goes with at least one of Anders, Aurora, or Beacon.
Cho's distance is lower than both the colonist in the Aurora module and the colonist in the Forge module.
Between Beacon and Forge, one goes with Cho and the other with 9 ly.
